title: Deadwater
subtitle: An investigative audio series about the case that haunted Long Island
description: An eight-part investigative podcast following journalist Sam Wilder through the Deadwater case: the discovery, the failed years, the forensic breakthrough, and the reckoning that followed.
author: Sam Wilder

episodes.title: The Find
episodes.subtitle: A search party finds something older and darker than the missing-person case they came to solve

episodes.title: The Department
episodes.subtitle: Inside the institution that failed the victims before the case went cold

episodes.title: Twelve Years of Silence
episodes.subtitle: Cold cases breathe, and the people who carry them keep listening

episodes.title: The Surveillance

episodes.title: Pizza Night
